note: Roles for the job board. Titles that differ on paper but are the same work are fused into one role. A posting takes the FIRST role whose title patterns match (case-insensitive) and whose exclude patterns do not; generic titles (e.g. 'Member of Technical Staff') fall back to the department patterns. soc = US SOC 2018 codes (BLS, O*NET, Anthropic Economic Index), noc = Canadian NOC 2021, indeed = Indeed Hiring Lab category used as the market-wide reference. exposures: signed weights on research directions (config/directions.json): + = progress there tends to create demand for the role, - = it automates the role's tasks. They are reviewed priors, to be calibrated against postings once months of data exist.
